title.zh: 【Morpho 支持以 Robinhood 股票代币为抵押品借入稳定币】
title.en: 【Morpho 支持以 Robinhood 股票代币为抵押品借入稳定币】

current_state.zh: Morpho has launched support for Robinhood stock tokens as collateral for stablecoin loans, with Robinhood Chain supplying the tokenization infrastructure and third-party apps able to integrate the lending markets.
